headline: Huawei Rejects US Court Conviction as Baseless, Threatens Legal Action
summary: Chinese technology giant Huawei called a US jury's verdict finding it guilty of stealing trade secrets without legal or factual merit, and announced plans to pursue all necessary legal actions.
why: Intellectual property disputes and legal rulings involving major technology firms affect international trade relations and cross-border tech operations.

impacts.name: Huawei
impacts.why: Adverse legal verdicts in key foreign jurisdictions present regulatory and operational hurdles for multinational firms.
